# Short #010 - Futurama: The 1939 World's Fair Vision of 1960

## Title options (1 = recommended)
1. In 1939, Millions Lined Up to See the Year 1960
2. Futurama: The 1939 Model That Predicted America's Highways
3. The One-Acre Model of the Future From the 1939 World's Fair

## Description
Futurama, designed by Norman Bel Geddes for General Motors at the 1939 New York World's Fair, showed America around 1960: a one-acre model with more than 500,000 buildings and about 50,000 cars, viewed from moving chairs. Up to 30,000 people a day waited in line. Its vision of a national expressway network is widely credited with influencing the Interstate Highway System.
